tests: [oopif.test] OOPIF should support frames within OOP iframes
reason: Calls frame.goto on a frame inside an out-of-process iframe; Strider has no navigation operation on a frame locator

tests: [oopif.test] OOPIF should exposeFunction on a page with a PDF viewer
[oopif.test] OOPIF should exposeFunction when an OOP iframe goes away mid-call
[oopif.test] OOPIF should support removing exposed function
reason: Page.exposeFunction has no Strider operation; Strider has no function bridge from the page's main world to the test

tests: [oopif.test] OOPIF should report console messages from OOP iframes to the browser and context
reason: Waits for the console message on the browser as well as the context; Strider has no browser-level console event, and the nearest matrix row is the context's

tests: [oopif.test] OOPIF should report requests from OOP iframes to the browser and context
reason: Waits for the request on the browser as well as the context; Strider has no browser-level request event, and the nearest matrix row is the context's
